description: Lightweight SVG dot-grid pattern rendered as an absolutely positioned full-size background layer. Dot size, spacing, and offset are all configurable via props (width, height, cx, cy, cr), and it accepts a className so a radial-gradient mask can be applied to fade the dots out toward the edges. Purely decorative and non-interactive; meant to sit behind hero or section content to add subtle texture.
example_prompts: Subtle dot pattern background behind a hero section
Minimal SVG grid of dots that fades out with a radial mask
Decorative background texture for a card or section, not too busy

description: Full-screen animated canvas background with roughly 1000 shard-shaped particles drifting across a dark charcoal backdrop. Particles react to the cursor with a magnetic vortex/swirl pull and glow brighter under friction the closer and faster they move near the pointer, with a trailing motion-blur effect. Includes a custom dot cursor and an optional centered text overlay. Best for a full hero/landing background that wants a moody, high-end, kinetic feel rather than a static image.
example_prompts: Dark interactive particle background that reacts to mouse movement
Premium atmospheric hero background with glowing particles and a vortex hover effect
Full-screen animated canvas background for a landing page with a custom cursor
